firstPlayerRule: For the opening round, the person who most recently wrote a letter by hand starts. Turns proceed clockwise.
officialTieBreak: The opening criterion has no stated tie-break. In later rounds, the previous round’s winner starts; if there were tied winners, choose randomly among them.
houseFallback: If no one can use the opening criterion, your group can agree to select randomly. This is a house rule for the opening round.
clarifications: Older editions can use a different opening criterion. This record is limited to the cited 21-card edition.
